description:
Three read-then-write sequences have a window between the read and the write: position assignment when adding to a day, the idempotent exercise create (select-then-insert on a unique index), and set numbering, which trusts a client-supplied setNumber.

None of them can bite a single user on one device, which is exactly why they should be closed before any multi-device work rather than discovered during it. The exercise create already has an FK-violation fallback that shows the shape of the fix: let the constraint arbitrate and handle the loser.
title: Close the check-then-act races
